_comment: Copy to providers.json and adjust. API keys never live here - they are read from the environment variable named by apiKeyEnvVar. Changing model/size/seconds is a config edit; adding a vendor that is not behind the LiteLLM gateway needs a new adapter in scripts/Providers.ps1.

image._notes: gpt-image-1 honours size (verified 1024x1536 vertical). gemini/gemini-2.5-flash-image ignores size and always returns 1024x1024. gemini/imagen-* returns 404 on this gateway.

video._notes: sora-2 at 720x1280 verified end to end. Render time varies widely - observed 70s to 400s for the same 4s clip, and a job can sit at 99% for minutes - hence the 15 minute poll ceiling. The still frame is auto-resized to match size. sora-2-pro and gemini/veo-3.1-* are offered by the gateway but untested here. Billing is per generated second, so seconds is the main cost lever.
